journey.name: receive direct channel funding
journey.description: Requires the rebuilt native direct-funding client and an online compatible primary on regtest, as described in the suite README. Use a separate funded sender to inspect and pay the copied URI. Repeat with no receiving channel, then with an existing receiving channel. Android-only feature.

actions.action: Open Receive, select Bitcoin, set an amount of 20000 sats and return to the QR
Tap Copy (testTag "ReceiveCopyQR") and inspect the copied URI in the compatible sender; verify it contains the Bitcoin address, amount=0.0002 and one nonempty bgnq parameter
If a Lightning invoice is available, verify the same URI retains its lightning parameter; select the Lightning tab and verify Copy contains only that Lightning invoice
Return to Bitcoin, change the amount to 30000 sats and copy again; verify the amount and signed direct-funding request change together
Disconnect the primary and verify a newly copied Bitcoin request has no bgnq parameter while its Bitcoin address remains available
Reconnect the primary, reopen Receive and copy the Bitcoin request; leave the QR open for ten minutes and verify the expired direct-funding parameter disappears

Create another 20000 sat request, copy it to the compatible sender, close Receive and pay its Lightning or Bitcoin fallback once; reopen Receive and verify the old direct request is no longer advertised
Verify the compatible sender rejects a later direct-funding attempt against that revoked request without committing a payer witness
